Dear Sir
I have consulting [sic] my [colleague](/person/329) as to whether she remembers having your daughter's little book She does not remember it, and I believe I had it, but did not think it came within scope of the [Monthly Packet](/periodical/52), and we have very little room for notices of books, so as only to be able to put in what bears on our purpose

yours truly

C M Yonge
